currypp.reason: IntegratedCode passes all 31 checks. All five Contracts modules now preprocess and compile, but execution fails with non-determinism in monadic actions occurred. Reproducer: in examples/Contracts, run curry-check --nospec --nosource --nodet --deftype=Int BubbleSort; the first generated sort7 check alone also fails. This is a new contract-execution failure, not a missing Debug.Profile primitive. The separate DeterministicOperations suite passes all nine tests; its earlier suspension does not recur. The separate DefaultRules suite analyzes all 14 modules and compiles its test main, passes both BreakWhere checks, and times out at 1800 seconds while evaluating the next check, BubbleSort.bsort7; the earlier evaluation timeout recurs (#242).
